task_definition.task_description: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, look up AAPL’s current stock information, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, and assess the risk for a $1,500 trade. Then, if that’s cleared, place a limit order for AAPL at 170.25, after that get the current NASDAQ market window and archive it as a post-trade market record for trader_42 in the app with medium priority, and finally check the status of my living room AC and turn it on.

user_input.query: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, then look up the current stock information for AAPL and get the USD to EUR exchange rate. After that, assess the risk for a $1500 trade. Then get the current NASDAQ market window and archive it in the app as a post-trade market record for trader_42 using the title Post-trade market archive with medium priority. Finally, check the status of my living room AC with device ID ac_living and turn it on so the desired power state is on.
